title: kith-peer: tests for delivery, retry, and rejection
description:
What: Comprehensive integration test suite for kith-peer: inbound Peer/deliver and Peer/receipt, outbox worker retry, and all rejection paths.

Algorithm:
1. Create crates/kith-peer/src/tests/ module (or test file) with in-memory Store (Store::open_in_memory())
2. Build test fixtures: mock WhoIs returning known Identity {user_id, login_name, display_name, node_name}; known owner_id; pre-seeded chat and message rows in store
3. Test group A — Peer/deliver happy path:
   - Construct valid PeerDeliverArgs with correct senderTailscaleUserId, correct chatId, valid ULID, small body, valid bodyType
   - Call DeliverHandler::call() directly with mock Caller
   - Assert: return value is Ok with accepted=true; messages table has one row with delivery_state=Received
   - Assert: contacts table has auto-created row for sender
4. Test group B — Peer/deliver rejections (each must verify ZERO DB writes):
   - Mismatched senderTailscaleUserId -> JmapError returned; no message row
   - Wrong chatId -> JmapError returned; no message row
   - Body > 65536 bytes -> JmapError returned
   - Invalid ULID id -> JmapError returned
   - Invalid bodyType -> JmapError returned
   - replyTo references non-existent message -> JmapError returned
5. Test group C — Peer/receipt:
   - Insert outgoing message (delivery_state=Pending) into store; call ReceiptHandler with kind=delivered -> delivery_state=Delivered in DB
   - Call ReceiptHandler with kind=read -> read_at set in DB
   - Call ReceiptHandler with messageId not in store -> JmapError::not_found
   - Call ReceiptHandler with messageId of inbound message (delivery_state=Received) -> JmapError::not_found
6. Test group D — Outbox worker retry:
   - Insert outgoing message + outbox row; set up mock PeerHttpClient that fails N times then succeeds
   - Advance time (or manipulate next_attempt_at); run one worker loop iteration
   - Assert: on success, outbox row deleted and message delivery_state=Delivered
   - Assert: on N failures, attempt_count increments; next_attempt_at advances per backoff formula
7. Run: cargo test -p kith-peer
8. Run: cargo clippy -p kith-peer -- -D warnings

Defensive rules:
- Tests MUST NOT use the code under test as oracle (no circular assertions)
- Rejection tests MUST verify zero DB writes (count rows before and after; assert row count unchanged)
- Each test is independent (fresh in-memory store per test)
- No time-sensitive waits (avoid tokio::time::sleep in tests); use direct handler calls
- Mock PeerHttpClient must implement a trait; not use real HTTPS in unit tests

Agent team: Tester T derives test vectors from kith-architecture.md and RFC 8620 (NOT from reading the implementation). Implementer I writes test harness and mock client. Validator V runs full test suite + clippy.

Tests (oracle = kith-architecture.md + RFC 8620 §3):
- All tests in groups A-D above; expected values are hardcoded from spec, not derived from running the code
